title: Bind the Kubernetes context to the ARM target
assertion: The explicit kubeconfig server hostname must match an endpoint returned for the explicit Azure target. This prevents combining evidence from different clusters.
remediation: Use a context obtained for this exact cluster. A DNS alias or proxy that cannot be matched requires independent identity verification; do not treat unverified binding as a pass.

title: Restrict cloud API-server exposure
assertion: The API is private, or has a nonempty authorized-IP list that does not contain a default route. This is configuration evidence, not an external reachability test.
remediation: Use private API connectivity or narrowly scoped authorized IP ranges. Independently validate DNS, firewall and administrative access paths.

title: Use an SLA-backed cloud production tier
assertion: Production clusters declare Standard or Premium tier. A tier setting alone does not prove application availability.
remediation: Review the control-plane SLA requirement and service tier against the workload SLO.

title: Enable Kubernetes RBAC
assertion: ARM explicitly reports enableRBAC=true.
remediation: Enable supported RBAC authorization and scope permissions to least privilege.

title: Use managed Microsoft Entra authentication
assertion: aadProfile.managed is explicitly true. Group membership, PIM and Conditional Access require separate evidence.
remediation: Integrate cluster authentication with managed Microsoft Entra ID and review privileged group access.

title: Disable local administrator accounts
assertion: disableLocalAccounts is explicitly true.
remediation: Validate Entra recovery access, then disable local accounts through an approved change.

title: Check workload identity and OIDC configuration
assertion: Workload identity requires OIDC. Both enabled is a configured capability, not proof that federated credentials or workload access work.
remediation: Enable OIDC with workload identity and separately verify service-account federation and least-privilege Azure grants.

title: Review cluster-admin bindings
assertion: Inventory cluster-admin subjects. A binding can be legitimate; authorization appropriateness cannot be inferred from its name.
remediation: Attach owner approval, break-glass design, access review, PIM and external Azure RBAC evidence.

title: Use dedicated workload service accounts
assertion: In-scope workload specifications name a non-default service account. This is isolation evidence, not a permission audit.
remediation: Assign dedicated service accounts and only the API or Azure permissions each workload needs.

title: Check node readiness
assertion: At least one node exists and every observed node has Ready=True.
remediation: Investigate node conditions, kubelet, connectivity, infrastructure health and scheduling impact.

title: Check node resource pressure
assertion: Every node explicitly reports MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure=False.
remediation: Correlate pressure with workload requests, disk usage and time-series infrastructure metrics.

title: Provide redundant cloud system-node capacity
assertion: Each operator-managed system pool has at least two nodes. AKS Automatic's service-managed system capacity requires separate review.
remediation: Use supported system pools with at least two nodes and validate headroom during maintenance.

title: Isolate system pools from application placement
assertion: Operator-managed system pools declare CriticalAddonsOnly=true:NoSchedule.
remediation: Review taints, tolerations and user pools before isolating system capacity.

title: Review node SKU, OS and special hardware support
assertion: Node inventory alone cannot certify supported VM sizes, GPU drivers, Windows licensing, firmware or physical headroom.
remediation: Attach current platform support, SKU availability, OS lifecycle, GPU/Windows constraints and capacity evidence.

title: Configure a cloud network-policy engine
assertion: networkPolicy is configured or the network dataplane is Cilium. Enablement is not proof of effective packet filtering.
remediation: Use a supported policy engine for the selected network model and validate actual allow/deny paths.

title: Declare default-deny ingress and egress baselines
assertion: Each in-scope workload namespace has all-pod policies with empty ingress and egress rules. Additive policy unions and engine enforcement still need runtime verification.
remediation: Create explicit default-deny baselines and narrowly scoped application/DNS exceptions; test effective isolation.

title: Review public service exposure
assertion: External IPs, NodePort and LoadBalancer services require an approved exposure model. Public endpoints are not automatically defects.
remediation: Validate listener ownership, private/public intent, firewall paths, WAF, certificates and authentication.

title: Declare TLS on Kubernetes Ingress objects
assertion: Every in-scope Ingress declares TLS. Upstream termination and Gateway API require independent review; certificate contents are not collected.
remediation: Configure TLS or document an approved upstream termination design, then validate protocol and certificate behavior.

title: Check ready service endpoints
assertion: Selector-based, non-ExternalName services have at least one explicitly ready EndpointSlice endpoint with an address.
remediation: Review selectors, readiness, target ports, endpoints and dataplane connectivity.

title: Detect cloud pod/service address conflicts
assertion: Observed pod/service CIDRs do not overlap and the configured DNS IP belongs to a service CIDR. VNet, peering and on-premises overlap are outside this limited comparison.
remediation: Reconcile the full address plan, routes, peering, DNS and dual-stack requirements before changing a network model.

title: Review egress, metadata isolation and DNS dependencies
assertion: Cluster settings do not prove NSG/UDR/firewall intent, SNAT headroom, metadata blocking, proxy behavior, private endpoints or effective DNS.
remediation: Attach effective routes, NSG/firewall decisions, DNS/LocalDNS tests, required outbound access, IPAM and SNAT metrics. Scope authorized packet tests separately.

title: Avoid privileged and Windows HostProcess containers
assertion: No in-scope regular, init or ephemeral container explicitly enables privileged or HostProcess mode.
remediation: Remove elevated modes unless a reviewed platform component requires them; record compensating controls.

title: Disable Linux privilege escalation
assertion: Every in-scope Linux container explicitly sets allowPrivilegeEscalation=false.
remediation: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation=false in application container security contexts.

title: Declare non-root Linux execution
assertion: Effective container/pod settings require non-root or a positive UID, with no contradictory UID 0 or explicit runAsNonRoot=false.
remediation: Use compatible non-root images and explicit pod/container security contexts; test filesystem and port permissions.

title: Drop Linux capabilities by default
assertion: Every in-scope Linux container drops ALL and does not add capabilities. Necessary additions require a reviewed exception.
remediation: Drop all capabilities and justify any narrowly required additions.

title: Avoid host namespace sharing
assertion: Workload specs do not enable hostNetwork, hostPID or hostIPC.
remediation: Remove host namespace sharing or document a platform-level exception and isolation controls.

title: Avoid hostPath mounts
assertion: In-scope workloads do not mount hostPath volumes. Host paths themselves are not persisted.
remediation: Use supported volume abstractions and avoid exposing host filesystems to applications.

title: Declare Linux seccomp isolation
assertion: Effective pod/container seccomp type is RuntimeDefault or Localhost. Local profile content and implicit node defaults are not verified.
remediation: Declare a supported seccomp profile and validate any custom profile on every eligible node.

title: Avoid unversioned and latest image references
assertion: Images use a non-latest explicit tag or a digest. Tags can still be mutable; signatures, CVEs and provenance remain manual review.
remediation: Prefer approved digest-pinned images with scanning, signing and controlled promotion.

title: Enable cloud Defender security monitoring
assertion: securityProfile.defender.securityMonitoring.enabled is explicitly true. Subscription plan, agent health and detection coverage are not established.
remediation: Review Defender for Containers plan, enablement, agent health, vulnerability assessment and alert routing.

title: Review service-account tokens and secret delivery
assertion: Secret values, environment variables, commands and mounted files are deliberately not harvested. Token necessity and vault/federation access need owner evidence.
remediation: Review automount settings, short-lived projected credentials, Key Vault/CSI use, rotation, image provenance and credential access. Do not attach secret values.

title: Declare positive CPU and memory requests
assertion: Regular and init application containers have positive CPU and memory requests. Requests are not a rightsizing measurement.
remediation: Set requests using representative observed demand and workload scheduling requirements.

title: Declare positive CPU and memory limits
assertion: Regular and init application containers declare positive CPU and memory limits. CPU-throttling tradeoffs require workload-specific review.
remediation: Set tested limits and review OOM/throttling time series; document intentional CPU-limit exceptions.

title: Declare readiness and liveness probes
assertion: Long-running regular containers declare readiness and liveness probes. Batch jobs are excluded; semantic probe correctness is not inferred.
remediation: Implement meaningful probes and a startup probe where initialization time requires it.

title: Detect request/limit conflicts
assertion: Comparable CPU and memory requests do not exceed limits. Missing or unparseable quantities cannot pass.
remediation: Correct inconsistent resource quantities and validate admission defaults and quotas.

title: Check Deployment rollout availability
assertion: Nonzero Deployments have current observed generation and at least their desired available replicas at collection time.
remediation: Investigate rollout conditions, image pulls, probes, scheduling, disruption budgets and recent changes.

title: Validate HPA replica bounds
assertion: Every observed HPA has valid min/max bounds. Metric freshness, target readiness and HPA/VPA interaction still require runtime review.
remediation: Correct replica bounds and test metrics, targets and scaling behavior under representative demand.

title: Detect failing application pods
assertion: No selected pod is Failed/Unknown or has CrashLoopBackOff, image-pull or container-configuration errors. Pending pods need review.
remediation: Investigate sanitized event reasons, rollout history, resource constraints and container health without collecting application secrets.

title: Run multiple replicas of persistent services
assertion: Nonzero Deployments and StatefulSets have at least two desired replicas.
remediation: Use multiple replicas where the application architecture permits and document single-instance constraints.

title: Declare matching PodDisruptionBudgets
assertion: Every multi-replica Deployment/StatefulSet is selected by a namespace-local PDB. This does not prove a disruption can complete.
remediation: Define appropriately scoped PDBs and test maintenance against real readiness and capacity.

title: Declare topology-aware placement
assertion: Multi-replica services declare topology spread or pod anti-affinity. Effective physical placement is not established.
remediation: Select supported host/zone fault domains and validate actual replica placement and scheduling behavior.

title: Declare cloud availability-zone diversity
assertion: Every operator-managed pool spans at least two zones; Microsoft recommends three where supported. Regional/SKU constraints need review.
remediation: Plan multi-zone capacity and application spreading, or document platform limitations and compensating recovery design.

title: Detect PDBs that configure zero voluntary disruption
assertion: For known selected replicas, PDB minAvailable does not consume all replicas and maxUnavailable is not zero. Other selected pod types require manual review.
remediation: Review intentional no-disruption requirements and their effect on drains, upgrades and surge capacity.

title: Check persistent volume claim binding
assertion: Every selected PVC explicitly reports Bound. An empty PVC list is not applicable, not a pass.
remediation: Review storage classes, capacity, access modes, topology, CSI events and backend health.

title: Use topology-aware Azure Disk binding
assertion: Observed disk.csi.azure.com storage classes use WaitForFirstConsumer. Other CSI drivers require their own support guidance.
remediation: Use topology-compatible dynamic provisioning and validate zone/scheduling interactions.

title: Review retention, encryption and storage recovery
assertion: Reclaim-policy and CSI-driver inventory does not prove backend encryption, application consistency, expansion support or recoverability.
remediation: Attach storage-specific encryption, access, expansion, snapshot/backup and tested restore evidence; decide Retain/Delete deliberately.

title: Route cloud Kubernetes audit logs
assertion: A diagnostic setting routes enabled kube-audit, kube-audit-admin, audit or allLogs to an observed destination. Ingestion, retention and completeness require queries.
remediation: Configure audit routing and verify recent records, retention, access controls and alerting at the destination.

title: Enable cloud managed Prometheus collection
assertion: azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled is explicitly true. Approved alternative metrics stacks need a documented exception.
remediation: Enable managed metrics or document an equivalent monitored stack and prove scrape freshness.

title: Enable cloud Container insights collection
assertion: The omsagent add-on is explicitly enabled. This flag does not prove log ingestion or retention.
remediation: Enable the supported logging integration or document an equivalent stack; validate end-to-end telemetry.

title: Review warning-event reasons
assertion: Warning reasons are point-in-time observations, not a complete incident history. Event messages are intentionally omitted.
remediation: Correlate event reasons and timestamps with metrics, operational history and approved log queries.

title: Verify actionable alerts and SLO telemetry
assertion: Static cluster inventory does not prove alert delivery, dashboard correctness, telemetry freshness or SLO compliance.
remediation: Attach recent log/metric queries, rule coverage, retention settings, ownership and an alert delivery test.

title: Enable the cloud Azure Policy add-on
assertion: The azurepolicy add-on is explicitly enabled. Assignments, enforcement mode, exemptions and compliance are not inferred.
remediation: Enable supported policy integration and separately review assigned initiatives, enforcement, exemptions and observed compliance.

title: Declare namespace resource quotas
assertion: Each selected workload namespace has a ResourceQuota with at least one hard limit. Limit suitability requires capacity review.
remediation: Define CPU, memory and object quotas appropriate to tenancy and workload capacity.

title: Review admission safeguards and compliance
assertion: PSA namespace labels and LimitRange inventory do not establish policy enforcement, assignment compliance or exception approval.
remediation: Review PSA/Gatekeeper/Azure Policy/Deployment Safeguards, defaults, drift, owners and approved exceptions. Validate denies with authorized server dry-runs.

title: Configure cloud workload capacity autoscaling
assertion: User pools enable cluster autoscaling, or node auto-provisioning mode is Auto. Fixed capacity may be an intentional exception.
remediation: Choose tested autoscaling or NAP limits aligned to quotas, SLOs, scheduling and predictable demand.

title: Validate cluster-autoscaler bounds
assertion: Autoscaled pools declare nonnegative minimums and positive maximums with minCount <= maxCount. Temporary surge counts are not treated as invalid bounds.
remediation: Correct autoscaler limits and verify Azure quota and upgrade/failure headroom.

title: Verify rightsizing and capacity economics
assertion: Requests, node counts and synthetic smoke latency cannot prove utilization, savings, throughput limits or production capacity.
remediation: Attach representative CPU/memory/storage/network percentiles, throttling, pricing/commitment evidence, workload SLOs and a separately approved load campaign.

title: Configure cloud Kubernetes automatic upgrades
assertion: An automatic Kubernetes upgrade channel other than none is configured.
remediation: Choose a supported upgrade strategy with staged testing, recovery and maintenance coordination.

title: Configure cloud node OS automatic updates
assertion: Node OS channel is SecurityPatch or NodeImage. Unmanaged/None needs an independently evidenced patch process.
remediation: Use a supported OS update channel or attach proof of timely alternative patching and reboot handling.

title: Declare cloud managed-upgrade maintenance windows
assertion: Both aksManagedAutoUpgradeSchedule and aksManagedNodeOSUpgradeSchedule have nonempty maintenanceWindow definitions. Other schedules are not equivalent.
remediation: Configure supported managed-upgrade windows and verify timing, duration and operational ownership.

title: Verify Kubernetes and image support windows
assertion: A version string or the existence of a newer version does not prove end of support. Support windows change and differ by platform and tier.
remediation: Attach current Microsoft version/OS support documentation, regional availability, image currency and an approved upgrade plan.

title: Prove application-consistent backup and restore
assertion: An installed backup product, snapshot or configured schedule is not proof of recoverability.
remediation: Attach successful restore timestamps, application/data validation, backup isolation, encryption, retention, RPO/RTO and ownership. Never exercise a restore against production implicitly.

title: Prove regional or site disaster recovery
assertion: One reachable cluster cannot demonstrate multi-region/site failover, dependency availability or business recovery objectives.
remediation: Attach a recovery topology, dependency/data replication design, DNS failover plan and separately authorized failover rehearsal.

title: Check Local ARM provisioning state
assertion: The Local provisioned cluster explicitly reports provisioningState=Succeeded. This does not prove physical-host or Arc-agent health.
remediation: Investigate provisioning operations, Arc resource bridge, connected-cluster agents and underlying host state.

title: Provide redundant Local control-plane nodes
assertion: controlPlane.count is 3 or 5, following the Local baseline recommendation of three to five control-plane nodes and quorum-aware sizing.
remediation: Review supported control-plane counts and spread them across actual physical failure domains.

title: Verify physical hosts, storage and security posture
assertion: Kubernetes and cluster ARM metadata cannot prove certified hardware, TPM/Secure Boot, BitLocker, firmware, Storage Spaces Direct or host failover health.
remediation: Attach approved Azure Local host validation, hardware/firmware lifecycle, encryption and physical fault-domain evidence. Reserve at least 15% host capacity as described in the Local baseline.

title: Verify Arc integration and disconnected-operation dependencies
assertion: An ARM show response does not prove Arc heartbeat, extension health, identity federation, outbound dependencies or disconnected-operation readiness.
remediation: Attach Arc agent/extension status, policy/Defender/Monitor evidence, required endpoints, local DNS/time synchronization and the deployment-specific connectivity design.

title: Resolve and reach a synthetic in-cluster service
assertion: An explicitly authorized probe pod resolves the synthetic service and receives its expected HTTP marker. Only this isolated path is tested.
remediation: Review test pod readiness, DNS/LocalDNS, service routing, approved test policies and image access. This does not validate all application network paths.

title: Exercise the synthetic HTTP end-to-end path
assertion: Three client requests through loopback-only kubectl port-forward return the expected marker. External ingress, WAF and TLS are not tested.
remediation: Investigate the synthetic workload and API port-forward path; separately authorize application-specific transaction tests.

title: Measure bounded synthetic load-smoke thresholds
assertion: Measured error percentage and nearest-rank p95 must meet the recorded operator-selected budgets. Safety caps: 200 requests, 4 workers, 30 seconds and 100 ms worker pacing. Budgets are not Microsoft SLOs.
remediation: Inspect measured results and test budgets. This smoke test is not saturation, soak, capacity certification or production application performance validation.

title: Validate restricted admission in the synthetic namespace
assertion: A privileged synthetic pod is rejected by restricted Pod Security Admission on a server-side dry-run. Unrelated RBAC or connectivity errors cannot count as successful rejection.
remediation: Review the isolated namespace's PSA enforcement. This negative test does not certify existing namespaces or constitute exploitation or a full penetration test.
